obligation: G060 baseline -- the current full-K/V path measured at real context, not at 128

kv_geometry.source: QWEN38_GQA_KV_HEADS read from qwen38_geometry.rs; confirmed by the token_ns receipt's gqa_kv_write_bytes = 131072

the_finding.statement: the context path moves 131,072 bytes per context position in 6.971 us, which is 18.8 GB/s against a measured 594.3 GB/s streaming roof -- 3.2% of it, roughly 32x off its own bandwidth bound

consequence_for_latent_kv: G060 proposes caching a latent instead of full K/V, which reduces BYTES. The path is at 3.2% of its bandwidth bound, so bytes are not what it is paying for. A 2x byte reduction on a path 32x off its roof buys at most 2x of a 32x problem, and it adds reconstruction cost on top. This is the same structural result as CODEC_ALU_COST: reducing bytes on a path that is not bandwidth-bound does not convert.
consequence_for_the_mission: The whole campaign has been optimising the 30.03 ms intercept. At 8192 context the context term is already 66% of the token, at 32768 it is 88%, at 131072 it is 97%. Decode at the model's own context limit is 1.06 TPS. The 100 TPS target is a SHORT-CONTEXT target and no amount of density or GEMV work touches the term that dominates an agent workload.
